name: Kikuri on the hunt
source: The trap is laid perfectly, and the bad man who did a lot of naughty things with petite girls can enjoy his last “meal”. He doesn’t have the faintest idea what kind of fate he will suffer in the near future.
translation: 陷阱已经完美布下，那个对娇小的女孩做了很多调皮事的坏男人可以享受他的最后一顿“大餐”了。他根本不知道自己在不久的将来会遭遇怎样的命运。
